intro: The Hunt Begins is a foundational rite of passage for young adventurers in Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. Tasked by Grull Hawkwind, initiates are sent to hunt local plainstriders to provide meat and feathers for the village. Fulfilling this task marks the first step toward earning the respect of Chief Hawkwind and eventually gaining entry into Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. Tauren hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The tauren of Narache thank you, friend. You show much promise.
